conceptZh: 一隻玩具貓頭鷹和一台小機器人進行瞪眼比賽，兩個都睜到最大、越靠越近；機器人先撐不住眨了一下，貓頭鷹得意地把頭整個轉了一圈，機器人只好認輸鼓掌。
object: a toy owl and a small toy robot
morph: the glyph 眼 stands still as a solid sculpture while the staring contest plays out below it
creativeAngle: 把字義變成一場比賽，孩子會跟著屏息看誰先眨眼，參與感很強。貓頭鷹轉頭一圈是牠獨有的動作，笑點跟其他支完全不同。眼為目部加艮共十一畫，目部孩子已經學過，字體靜止保結構。語音詞「眼睛」，眼ㄧㄢˇ、睛ㄐㄧㄥ都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale peach background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 眼 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep indigo, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 目 radical on the left, with its two inner horizontal strokes evenly spaced, sits beside the 艮 component on the right, both clearly separated. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Along its base a round toy owl and a small boxy toy robot face each other, both with their eyes opened as wide as they possibly go. From 0.6 seconds neither moves. They lean slowly closer, and closer, until their faces are almost touching, eyes straining even wider. Hold the tension from 1.4 to 2.6 seconds with nothing happening at all. At 2.8 seconds the robot's visor flickers once - a blink - and he claps both hands over his eyes, caught. The owl does not blink. At 3.4 seconds it rotates its head slowly all the way around in one smooth, smug circle and brings it back to face front. The robot applauds politely in defeat, and the two of them waddle out of frame to the right together by 4.6 seconds. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 眼 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「眼、眼、眼睛」, using the reading ㄧㄢˇ for 眼 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 眼 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 眼睛 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 眼: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
